description.p: Omatrack is a native telemetry workstation for drivers and engineers. It normalizes heterogeneous logger formats into one lap model for trace overlays, distance-aligned delta, corner analysis, and synchronized onboard video.

ul.li: Reads Pi/Cosworth PDS, MoTeC LD, Racelogic VBO, and AiM MP4 telemetry
Compares laps with or without usable GPS
Keeps source telemetry and video immutable

description.p: Native .telemetry companions as the only analysis file, primary video as the playback clock with reference catch-up on straights, five fullscreen compose layouts, an iRacing-style live delta bar, and Δt taken at the same 50 Hz lap-progress station as traces and video. Sidebar rows group by day. Corner notes and hover chips use that same station map.

S3 and Google Cloud Storage library sources, streamed onboard video with offline pin and signed-URL recovery, portable recording sidecars and create-only AiM companions, automatic USB discovery, representative lap selection, and non-blocking library I/O.

Session-confidence trace bands, multi-lap brake-point consistency, improved corner focus guides, stabilized dual-video synchronization, click-only video seeking from traces, and a compact fixed-position fullscreen telemetry HUD.

GPU scene-graph trace renderer, in-place corner analysis with a pluggable check system, authenticated WebDAV telemetry sources, Windows flat release zips, and unified telemetry/video file opening with recent-file history.

Cached GPS/speed track-station alignment shared by traces, delta and synchronized video; lazy cached library indexing; pinned upstream Rust telemetry crates; fullscreen telemetry HUD and video/folder metadata workflow; downloadable Linux, macOS and Windows builds.
